sectors.rationale: Semiconductors, cloud infrastructure, and software are direct expressions of AI investment.
Digital platforms and communications infrastructure are meaningful channels for AI adoption.
Data-center expansion is developing a structural connection through increased power demand.
Data-center construction and supporting infrastructure create a developing industrial connection.
Energy producers and services are the most direct sector expression of energy and commodity developments.
Materials businesses are meaningfully connected through commodity production and input prices.
Utilities are meaningfully connected through fuel costs and sensitivity to energy input prices.
Financial businesses are directly exposed to interest rates, credit conditions, and the shape of the yield curve.
Real estate is meaningfully connected through financing costs and rate sensitivity.
Discretionary spending can face counter-pressure when financial conditions tighten.
